title: MIFARE 4K Cards
description: MIFARE 4K cards for higher-memory 13.56 MHz credentials in access, ticketing and multi-application legacy MIFARE deployments.
summary: MIFARE 4K cards provide higher memory than standard 1K credentials, making them suitable for legacy MIFARE projects that need more on-card application storage.
High Capacity: With a whopping 4KB storage, this card can securely hold a treasure trove of data, from access credentials to loyalty points.
Contactless Brilliance: Say goodbye to fumbling with keys or swiping cards. The MIFARE 4K S70 operates seamlessly in the contactless realm, making transactions and access control a breeze.
